Hymn 51: Sons of Michael, He Approaches
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: C Major
Composer: Arndt L. Christensen
Lyricist/Text Author: Eliza R. Snow
Category: Praise to the Lord

This is hymn number 51 titled "Sons of Michael, He Approaches" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in C Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Arndt L. Christensen and the lyrics were written by Eliza R. Snow.
This hymn is categorized under: Praise to the Lord.
